build: -DMRV_SCAN_DIAGNOSTICS only; absent without the flag (verified: 0 g_mrv_diag refs in plain preprocessed output)

authoritative_forced.counts: forced_out entries pushed during the one_deg_set re-collection (metric 10)
authoritative_forced.definition: incremented once per push_back in the authoritative collection loop

avoided_tail.counts: active columns the original full scan would still have examined after the candidate's early exit (metric 7)
avoided_tail.definition: diag_full_active - diag_visits at exit; exact via one extra packed pass per call (diagnostic build only)

calls.definition: incremented once per call on every return path

discarded_pushes.counts: degree-1 pushes the original scan would have attempted but which were cleared before use (metric 9)
discarded_pushes.definition: counted inline for visited columns only; post-exit columns never pushed in either version

early_exit_hist.counts: per-call visit count at the moment of zero-degree exit

max_visits.counts: maximum active-column visits in any single call (metric 11)

no_zero_calls.counts: calls completing the full active set with no zero (metric 6)

visited.counts: active columns visited by the candidate scan (metrics 2 and 8)

zero_calls.counts: calls encountering a degree-zero active column (metric 3)
zero_calls.definition: count==0 observed on a visited active column

zero_pos_sum.counts: sum of 0-based visit indices of the first zero (metric 4)
zero_pos_sum.definition: diag_visits-1 at exit; divide by zero_calls for the mean

instrumentation_overhead: one extra packed-bitset pass per MRV call (diag_full_active) plus integer increments; diagnostic build only
interpretation_rule: avoided/discarded counts measure workload exposure, NOT elapsed-time savings; never compare diagnostic elapsed time against release builds
report_line: MRV-DIAG calls=.. visited=.. zero_calls=.. zero_pos_sum=.. no_zero_calls=.. avoided_tail=.. discarded_pushes=.. authoritative_forced=.. max_visits=.. exit_hist=[..]
semantics_guarantee: counters never influence selection, tie-break, degrees, one_deg_set, forced output, dead ends, or search; branch structure identical except counter increments
